notes.title: Hotfix 22-01-15
notes.content:
This is the first hotfix for Reloader: test_subject!


[h2]Miscellaneous[/h2]

[list][*] Changed the dialogue sound effect.
[*] Changed the position of the buttons for the option menu.[/list]

Completing a stage with a pistol with the magazine removed will no longer generate a new magazine for the next stage.
